name: Egg breakfast burritos + fruit
equipment: foil or a covered pan for holding
notes: "Lots of eggs" per the scoutmaster: planned 2.5 eggs per kid, 3.5 per adult.
Build-your-own: scrambled eggs, shredded cheese, peppers/onions, salsa. No meat, so it is pork- and beef-free and works for vegetarians.
Ask about egg allergies; a scout with one needs a separate plan.
Cooking staples: butter for the eggs, cooking spray for the griddle, salt, pepper, hot sauce on the line.
Crew: Young scouts (K-2nd) help with fruit and serving; adults run the griddles.
Storage: bag opened tortillas, shredded cheese and leftover diced onions/peppers; label, date, back in the cooler.
roles: Griddle leads (2 adults): veggies, eggs, tortillas
Prep (1 adult): crack and whisk eggs, dice veggies
Line lead (1 adult) + kid helpers: fruit, setting out the line, serving cheese and salsa

steps.text: Handwash station up (water jug, soap, paper towels). Wipe down prep tables. Set up griddles and burners; check fuel.
Set the sealed kosher meals aside on a separate, labeled tray. They are not opened or heated on our griddles.
Adults: dice {onion} and {bell_pepper} on cutting boards. Kids: wash hands, glove up, and set out whole fruit ({fruit}) in bins.
Crack {eggs} into large bowls, about 5 dozen per bowl. Whisk in a little salt and pepper. Keep the bowls in the cooler until they go on the griddle.
Griddles to medium. Melt a little butter, then saute the peppers and onions 5 minutes until soft. Move them to a covered pan.
Scramble the eggs in batches (about 2 dozen per griddle at a time) with butter. Cook until firm with no runny parts. Hold in covered foil pans at the cool edge of the griddle.
Warm the tortillas ({tortilla_burrito}) 15-20 seconds per side; stack them in foil to stay soft.
Set out the line: tortillas, eggs, peppers & onions, shredded cheese ({cheese_shredded}), salsa ({salsa}), hot sauce, fruit, napkins.

serving: One burrito each to start; seconds once everyone has gone through.
About 1/3 cup of eggs per burrito. Adults serve the eggs; kids can serve cheese and fruit.
Hot sauce stays at the end of the line, away from little hands.
food_safety: Raw eggs stay in the cooler until they hit the griddle. Separate spoons for raw and cooked eggs.
Cook eggs until firm (160°F). Cooked eggs are out no more than 2 hours (1 hour above 90°F).
Change gloves after handling raw eggs or shells.
cleanup: Scrape griddles while warm. Egg shells and food scraps go in the trash, not the fire (critters).
Leftover cooked eggs are thrown out, not saved.
Bag and label opened tortillas, cheese, and leftover diced veggies (see carry-forwards).

diet.vegetarian: Everything on the line is vegetarian (no meat at this meal).
diet.halal: OK as served: no meat, and the cheese is kosher-certified (no animal rennet).
diet.kosher: Sealed kosher meal (shared griddles aren't kosher). Hand it over unopened.
diet.gluten_free: Tortillas contain wheat. Serve eggs, veggies and fruit in a bowl, or bring GF tortillas.
diet.nut_free: No nuts on this menu; check the salsa label.
